resources.string: omakey works entirely offline. It sends no typed text anywhere, and includes no analytics or ad SDKs. Your personal dictionary, clipboard history, and theme choices are stored only on this device. The one exception: checking for app updates, which looks up the latest release on GitHub — either manually via the button below, or automatically every 12 hours if you leave \"Automatic update checks\" on (toggle below; on by default). Either way, that lookup is the only thing that ever touches the network — no typed text, no other data, nothing else in the app.
